title: The Stranger on the Bench
description: An elderly stranger sits alone on a park bench, feeding pigeons. They catch your eye and gesture for you to come sit. Something about their weathered face feels like a story waiting to be told—or a danger you can't quite name.

outcomes.narration: The stranger's name is Miriam. She tells you about the love of her life—a jazz pianist who played in clubs that no longer exist. Her eyes light up in a way that makes her look young again. Before you leave, she presses a worn photograph into your hand. 'For when you're older,' she whispers.

You nod politely but keep your distance. The stranger smiles understandingly and returns to feeding the pigeons. Sometimes wisdom means knowing when not to engage—but you wonder for years what stories Miriam might have told.
